reasons.text: חוב/הון 509%, מזומן קטן מהחוב, יחס שוטף 0.2, תזרים מזומנים חופשי שלילי

about: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a cruise company in North America, Europe, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It offers itineraries to destinations, such as Europe, Asia, Australia, New Zealand, South America, Africa, Canada, Bermuda, the Caribbean, and Alaska; and inter-island itinerary in Hawaii.
